title: Monopsony Makes It Big
title_zh: 买方垄断做大
title_primary: 买方垄断做大
title_secondary: Monopsony Makes It Big
authors: Caldwell, Sydnee, Dube, Arindrajit, Naidu, Suresh
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The literature on imperfect competition in labor markets has expanded rapidly in recent years. This article provides a guide to the field, focusing on the firm-specific (“residual”) labor supply elasticity as the definition of a firm’s labor market power. We present a general framework showing how this elasticity nests the three widely studied sources of monopsony power: search frictions, preference heterogeneity, and employer concentration. We summarize the empirical estimates of the elasticity of labor supply, highlighting sources of possible heterogeneity. We emphasize that it is difficult to infer elasticities from markdowns (and vice versa) due to the diversity of firm wage-setting practices, illustrating this point using the interaction between monopsony and efficiency wages. We discuss how policy issues in antitrust, labor market regulation, immigration, and macroeconomics interact with monopsony and conclude by listing several areas for future research.
abstract_zh: 近年来，关于劳动力市场不完全竞争的文献迅速增长。本文为该领域提供指南，聚焦于企业特定（“剩余”）劳动力供给弹性作为企业劳动力市场势力的定义。我们提出一个通用框架，展示该弹性如何涵盖三种被广泛研究的买方垄断势力来源：搜索摩擦、偏好异质性和雇主集中度。我们总结了劳动力供给弹性的实证估计，强调可能存在的异质性来源。我们指出，由于企业工资制定实践的多样性，难以从工资加价中推断弹性（反之亦然），并通过买方垄断与效率工资的相互作用阐明这一观点。我们讨论了反垄断、劳动力市场监管、移民和宏观经济学中的政策问题如何与买方垄断相互影响，最后列出未来研究的若干方向。

title_primary: 检测公共采购中的偏袒行为

authors: Joosua Virtanen, Janne Tukiainen, Susmita Baulia
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Favoritism as a mode of corruption is a major concern in public procurement (PP) in many countries. We propose a regression discontinuity design (RDD) test arguing that the winning history of marginal winners and losers can be used to detect favoritism. We apply the empirical test to PP of cleaning services in Finland and find evidence of favoritism even in this relatively low corruption environment. First, winners of close races in terms of win margin tend to have won more also in the past, which is in contrast to competitive environment. Second, to rule out an alternative explanation of collusion based on incumbency, we show that these winners also tend to submit their bids the last, indicating information sharing about rival bids from the buyer to the favored bidder.
abstract_zh: 偏袒作为一种腐败形式，是许多国家公共采购（PP）中的主要问题。我们提出了一种断点回归设计（RDD）检验，认为边际获胜者与失败者的获胜历史可用于检测偏袒行为。我们将该实证检验应用于芬兰清洁服务公共采购中，发现即使在腐败程度相对较低的环境中，偏袒现象依然存在。首先，以微弱优势获胜的竞标者（即获胜幅度接近的竞标者）往往在过去也赢得更多合同，这与竞争性环境形成对比。其次，为排除基于在位优势的合谋替代解释，我们证明这些获胜者还倾向于最后提交标书，这表明买方与受偏袒的竞标者之间存在关于竞争对手报价的信息共享。

title: Reskilling and Resilience
title_zh: 技能重塑与韧性
title_primary: 技能重塑与韧性
title_secondary: Reskilling and Resilience
authors: Humlum, Anders, Plato, Pernille
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper shows that effective reskilling substantially reduces antidepressant use among injured workers and their partners. Exploiting institutional variation in access to higher education following work accidents in Denmark, we find that reskilling prevents antidepressant use for one in three participants, with partner spillovers of comparable magnitude. These effects emerge while workers are in school—prior to any income gains—and coincide with increased partner employment. Assuming a one-to-one mapping between prescriptions and depressive episodes, the value of these health improvements adds 50% to the direct labor earnings gains from reskilling; partner earnings gains add another 33%.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，有效的技能重塑显著降低了工伤工人及其伴侣的抗抑郁药物使用。利用丹麦工伤事故后高等教育机会的制度差异，我们发现技能重塑使每三名参与者中有一人避免了抗抑郁药物使用，且伴侣的溢出效应规模相当。这些效应在工人仍在学期间——即在任何收入增长之前——便已显现，并与伴侣就业增加同步发生。假设处方与抑郁发作之间存在一一对应关系，这些健康改善的价值使技能重塑带来的直接劳动收入增益增加了50%；伴侣收入增益则额外增加了33%。

title: Not just a random forest: Using Bayesian additive regression trees to estimate willingness to pay to protect critical habitat
title_zh: 不仅仅是随机森林：使用贝叶斯加性回归树估计保护关键栖息地的支付意愿
title_primary: 不仅仅是随机森林：使用贝叶斯加性回归树估计保护关键栖息地的支付意愿
title_secondary: Not just a random forest: Using Bayesian additive regression trees to estimate willingness to pay to protect critical habitat
authors: Lendie Follett, Brian Vander Naald, Sonja H. Kolstoe
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We introduce a fully nonparametric estimator to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) using contingent valuation (CV) data. Traditional methods such as the probit model are used because of their roots in utility theory as well as their ease to implement. However, they are limited by their reliance on strict parametric assumptions, such as linearity and the requirement that the researcher pre‐select important covariates. While these methods are widely used, they may fail to capture complex relationships, particularly in situations involving nonlinearity or interactions among variables. This paper introduces Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) as a flexible, nonparametric way to estimate WTP from CV studies. Using a simulation study, we demonstrate that BART is competitive with traditional models under strict data‐generating assumptions. When the underlying data‐generating process is more complex, BART outperforms traditional models and even other machine‐learning models. Moreover, BART automatically incorporates individual heterogeneity into estimation, making it more informative than traditional nonparametric estimators. We illustrate the breadth of the model's benefits with an empirical application estimating WTP to develop an Invasive Species Rapid Response Fund in the Hawaiian Islands. We find WTP distributional differences along the margins of gender, age, and income. We also construct willingness to pay curves out of Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) draws and calculate posterior means and credible intervals using empirical cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). We find these WTP to be lower than those from the probit. Future natural extensions of BART make this method a compelling alternative for estimating WTP in CV experiments.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种完全非参数估计方法，利用条件价值评估（CV）数据来估计支付意愿（WTP）。传统方法如probit模型因其植根于效用理论且易于实施而被广泛使用。然而，这些方法受限于严格的参数假设，例如线性关系以及研究者需预先选择重要协变量的要求。尽管这些方法应用广泛，但在涉及非线性或变量间交互作用的复杂情境中，可能无法捕捉真实关系。本文引入贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）作为一种灵活的非参数方法，用于从CV研究中估计WTP。通过模拟研究，我们证明在严格的数据生成假设下，BART与传统模型表现相当。当底层数据生成过程更为复杂时，BART优于传统模型甚至其他机器学习模型。此外，BART自动将个体异质性纳入估计，使其比传统非参数估计器更具信息量。我们通过一项实证应用展示了该模型的广泛优势，该应用估计了夏威夷群岛建立入侵物种快速响应基金的支付意愿。研究发现，WTP在性别、年龄和收入边际上存在分布差异。我们还利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）抽样构建了支付意愿曲线，并通过经验累积分布函数（CDFs）计算后验均值和可信区间。结果显示，这些WTP估计值低于probit模型的结果。BART未来的自然扩展使其成为CV实验中估计WTP的有力替代方法。

title: The impact of global sanctions on cross-border mergers and acquisitions

title_primary: 全球制裁对跨境并购的影响
title_secondary: The impact of global sanctions on cross-border mergers and acquisitions
authors: Naoto Jinji, Shigenobu Kawaguchi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The use of sanctions has grown steadily over the past seven decades, with well-documented effects on bilateral trade. This column analyses the effects of sanctions on cross-border mergers and acquisitions from sanctioning to target countries over the period 2006-2023. It finds that sanctions reduce the number of deals by around 50%, with stronger effects as time passes. The impact is stronger in the mining, manufacturing, and energy sector than in the services sector. The results reinforce the broad-based potential effects of sanctions on private sector economic activity.
abstract_zh: 过去七十年来，制裁的使用稳步增长，其对双边贸易的影响已有充分文献记载。本文分析了2006年至2023年期间制裁对从制裁国到目标国的跨境并购的影响。研究发现，制裁使交易数量减少约50%，且随着时间的推移，影响更为显著。采矿、制造和能源行业受到的影响比服务业更大。这些结果强化了制裁对私营部门经济活动可能产生的广泛影响。

title: Enforcing discipline in China: Countering internal misinformation with public disclosure
title_zh: 中国纪律执行：以公开披露应对内部虚假信息
title_primary: 中国纪律执行：以公开披露应对内部虚假信息
title_secondary: Enforcing discipline in China: Countering internal misinformation with public disclosure
authors: Handi Li, Shengqiao Lin, Minh D. Trinh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Governments around the world need internal discipline to ensure the implementation of policies and delivery of governance outputs, and this need is more severe in authoritarian systems that govern top-down and without bottom-up electoral pressures. Conventional wisdom suggests that autocrats rely on punishment to discipline subordinates who fail to obey orders, but we argue that public disclosure of such malfeasance can also be effective, even when unaccompanied by punishment. In the case of internal misinformation—the tampering of government data and statistics by local agents to distort central authorities’ decisions—we find that the Chinese government successfully adopted public disclosure to combat the manipulation of local GDP numbers by lower-level governments. Our evidence indicates that publicly disclosing a prior act of falsification reduced future manipulation and did so at various levels of local governments, even as officials implicated by the disclosure faced no career setbacks. Hinting at downstream impacts, such disclosure also improved confidence among economic actors, evidenced by increased business activity in localities involved in public disclosures.

title: How Do State “Auto-IRA” Policies Affect Household Balance Sheets?

authors: Adam Bloomfield, Ngoc Dao, Kyung Min Lee, Sita Slavov
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine how state policies requiring firms to facilitate workplace retirement saving affect household balance sheets. Using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP), we compare private-sector workers likely exposed to Oregon’s Automatic-Enrollment Individual Retirement Account (Auto-IRA) policy with similar workers in not-yet-adopting states. We find that the Auto-IRA policy is associated with increases in IRA and employer-sponsored retirement plan ownership and assets. We also find increases in checking or savings account ownership and balances, as well as higher credit card debt. The results suggest that Auto-IRA policies spill over to household liquidity management and borrowing.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了要求企业促进职场退休储蓄的州政策如何影响家庭资产负债表。利用收入与项目参与调查（SIPP）数据，我们将可能受俄勒冈州自动注册个人退休账户（Auto-IRA）政策影响的私营部门员工与尚未实施该政策的州的类似员工进行比较。研究发现，Auto-IRA政策与IRA及雇主资助退休计划的持有率及资产增加相关。同时，该政策还伴随着支票或储蓄账户持有率及余额的提升，以及信用卡债务的增加。结果表明，Auto-IRA政策会溢出至家庭流动性管理与借贷行为。

abstract: We estimate the global price of credit risk from a large cross section of global corporate bond returns. We show that a single factor, constructed as a nonlinear function of past credit spreads, equity market volatility, and their interactions, prices bond returns in both the time series and the cross section. The factor significantly outperforms alternative measures of global financial conditions, explaining up to 13% of variation in bond-level three-month-ahead returns. A high global price of credit risk further translates into deteriorations in local credit conditions, outflows from global funds, and higher expected returns to global funds.
abstract_zh: 本文研究金融状况如何影响专注于绿色创新的企业的研发活动。通过将美国专利数据与Compustat数据库匹配，我们将“绿色创新者”定义为绿色专利累计占比高的企业。尽管这些企业在绿色专利总量中占比很小，但它们处于绿色创新生态系统的核心位置。通过估算企业层面对外生广义金融状况变化的脉冲响应，我们发现金融紧缩对专业化绿色创新企业的研发产生了不成比例的大幅且持续的负面效应。相比之下，多元化创新者和非创新者的研发反应较弱。绿色创新者通常更年轻、规模更小且更依赖外部融资，这表明金融紧缩对上游绿色技术发展引入了系统性偏见。

title: Berge equilibria – an algebraic approach
title_zh: 伯格均衡——一种代数方法
title_primary: 伯格均衡——一种代数方法
title_secondary: Berge equilibria – an algebraic approach
authors: Frank Riedel, Maria-Laura Torrente
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Berge equilibrium offers an alternative to Nash equilibrium in game theory, emphasizing cooperative stability rather than individual optimization. Despite recent interest, a systematic study of Berge equilibria in finite normal form games is still lacking, with fundamental questions like existence remaining open. This paper characterizes Berge equilibria through a polynomial system of equations, enabling computational algebra and algebraic geometry methods to analyze them. Algorithms based on Gröbner bases determine the existence and computation of Berge equilibria. Furthermore, we show that the set of games admitting completely mixed Berge equilibria is contained within a determinantal variety, whose dimension we explicitly bound from above.
abstract_zh: 伯格均衡为博弈论中的纳什均衡提供了一种替代方案，强调合作稳定性而非个体最优化。尽管近期研究兴趣渐增，但有限正规型博弈中伯格均衡的系统性研究仍显不足，诸如存在性等基本问题尚未解决。本文通过多项式方程组刻画伯格均衡，从而能够运用计算代数和代数几何方法对其进行分析。基于格罗布纳基的算法可判定伯格均衡的存在性并实现其计算。此外，我们证明存在完全混合伯格均衡的博弈集合包含于某一行列式簇中，并给出了该簇维数的显式上界。

title: Universalism: an 11‐year longitudinal study
title_zh: 普遍主义：一项11年纵向研究

title_secondary: Universalism: an 11‐year longitudinal study
authors: Christine Bangum, Benny Geys, Rune Sørensen
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How individuals make trade‐offs between socially proximate or distant groups impacts upon a wide range of social, political and economic behaviours. This paper exploits Norwegian administrative register data over the 2012–2022 period to assess whether, and if so how, such ‘(moral) universalism’ develops as individuals age and go through major life events. We show that ageing is associated with increases in universalism in early adulthood and declining universalism among older individuals, but the magnitude of these changes remains very small. Similarly, major life events—such as starting higher education, first‐time parenthood, positive income shocks and retirement—are linked to at best minor and short‐lived changes in universalism. These results add important insights regarding the (in)stability of individuals' value orientations during adulthood, and raise new questions about the potential influence of broader social forces on universalism across cohorts.
abstract_zh: 个体如何在社交亲近或疏远群体之间进行权衡，会影响广泛的社会、政治和经济行为。本文利用挪威2012-2022年期间的行政登记数据，评估这种“（道德）普遍主义”是否会随年龄增长及经历重大人生事件而发生变化，以及如何变化。我们发现，年龄增长与成年早期普遍主义的上升及老年个体普遍主义的下降相关，但这些变化的幅度非常微小。同样，重大人生事件——如开始接受高等教育、首次成为父母、正向收入冲击及退休——最多仅与普遍主义的微小且短暂变化相关。这些结果为了解成年期个体价值取向的（不）稳定性提供了重要见解，并引发了关于更广泛社会力量对不同世代普遍主义潜在影响的新问题。

title_zh: 葡萄牙在非洲与亚洲的帝国，1415-1975
title_primary: 葡萄牙在非洲与亚洲的帝国，1415-1975
title_secondary: Portugal's Empire in Africa and Asia, 1415-1975
authors: Nuno Palma, Fernanda Ortega, Dennis Snower, William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn
official: 官方在线 2025-10-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Portugal’s empire began with the conquest of Ceuta (1415) and lasted until the decolonization process (1974-1975). Portugal, therefore, both led the first wave of Western colonization and became the last to relinquish its empire during the twentieth century. Concentrating on the African and Asian dimensions of Portugal's empire, I offer a comparison with other European empires, summarizing relevant events and chronologies. Issues covered include openness ver-sus protection, slavery and slave trading, the role of early colonial settlers, and the empire's impact on both the metropolitan economy and the regions that were colonized.
abstract_zh: 葡萄牙帝国的历史始于1415年征服休达，直至1974-1975年的非殖民化进程。因此，葡萄牙既是西方殖民浪潮的引领者，也是20世纪最后一个放弃帝国的殖民国家。本文聚焦葡萄牙帝国在非洲和亚洲的维度，通过与其他欧洲帝国的比较，梳理相关历史事件与时间脉络。研究议题涵盖开放与保护主义、奴隶制与奴隶贸易、早期殖民定居者的作用，以及帝国对宗主国经济与殖民地区域的双重影响。
